question.text: Which of the following institutions facilitates the smooth functioning of the depository system?

answer.text: Depositories, Stock Exchanges, Clearing Corporations, Depository Participants (DPs), Issuers, and Registrars and Transfer Agents (RTAs), acting together
Only Stock Exchanges and Clearing Corporations

explanation.text: The Logic: The depository system is supported by a network of institutions: depositories themselves, stock exchanges, clearing corporations, depository participants (DPs), issuers, and registrars and transfer agents (RTAs). Each plays a distinct role — exchanges provide trade data, clearing corporations issue settlement instructions, DPs interface with investors, and issuers/RTAs handle corporate actions. The Trap: "Only Depositories and DPs" captures the core depository infrastructure but ignores the broader ecosystem of exchanges, clearing corporations, issuers and RTAs that the workbook explicitly lists. Note: The keyed option was rewritten as a standalone comprehensive list (instead of "All of the above") so the item stays correct under answer randomization. The unsupported Cross-Exam Context and Pro-Tip paragraphs were removed.
